title: Saudi Coalition Reports Fatal Helicopter Crash Near Najran
excerpt: An AH-6i helicopter crash near the Saudi-Yemeni border resulted in two deaths, attributed by the Saudi-led coalition to a technical malfunction.
author: LokkeeVerse Editorial
content:
A military helicopter crash near the border with Yemen has resulted in two fatalities, according to statements from the Saudi-led coalition.

The incident involved an AH-6i helicopter that came down near the city of Najran. Coalition representatives attributed the crash to a technical fault.

The crash occurred in the context of ongoing operations and heightened cross-border attacks involving Houthi forces.
seoTitle: Two Killed in Saudi AH-6i Helicopter Crash Near Najran
metaDescription: A Saudi-led coalition AH-6i helicopter crashed near Najran due to a technical fault, leaving two dead near the Yemeni border.
